caption_L1: Costs of a night out for two people in the most expensive United States cities in 2014 (in U.S. dollars) is a bar plot. The y-axis shows Dinner for two as linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 80 while the x-axis plots most expensive United States cities as categorical scale starting at Boston, MA and ending at Washington, D.C..
caption_L2L3: All of the cities come in at over $60. Washington DC was the most expensive at well over $80. Portland OR was the least expensive at around $70. San Diego was the next least expensive but with a big increase to nearly $80. The average price would tend to be around the $80 mark.
